did: Five HOST stories landed. Spoken cards now join with a held crossfade where the cast keeps its place. The owner's long takes are conditioned: the record button's click is found by its shape, pauses are cut to 280 milliseconds except where a breath is kept whole, and the take is sped to 1.2 and levelled. Conversations keep a second record schema, an append-only log where the agent offers previews and the owner picks one, a pick can be changed without losing the first, and old records still read. A turn cut from a long take now starts and ends in the take's own silence instead of on a word, after the owner's m4 opened on the tail of a word. On the phone, Studio has a Previews screen where only Use this picks, and its sample keeps nothing.

calls.title: A preview's author is the agent, and the owner's pick never names a rule
options: The agent writes an offer event and the owner's approve names only its variant
The owner's approve restates the offer and writes the rule's name
Home writes the offer once its clips are rendered
calls.why: The owner's guard says the owner only chooses; the agent proposes the bundle and its rules, and home checks the clips are made.
calls.undo: Move C1582: give approve back its offered, recommended and rule fields.

calls.title: A turn's edge is the silence nearest the transcript's boundary
options: The silence nearest the transcript's boundary
calls.why: The midpoint cut words because the transcriber's words abut, and the longest silence chose a stop's closure inside a word; nearest held every case the tests generate.
calls.undo: Change silenceBetween in owner-takes; the forced alignment story, #3585, replaces the guess with real word boundaries.

calls.title: A pause runs over 280 milliseconds where a breath is kept whole
options: Keep a breath the cut would reach into, and let that pause run long
Hold every pause to 280 and cut into the breath
calls.why: The owner's tiebreaker is natural and never jarring: a clipped release or inhale is jarring, and a slightly longer pause is not.
calls.undo: Move C1564's breath rule in TAKE_POLICY.

left: Home's previews port: the phone keeps picks on itself until paulgsc/server#1245 lands and its routes reach the route snapshot.
Forced alignment of words to the audio, #3585, since a transcript off by more than half a word's length or a closure nearer the boundary than the gap is outside TAKE1.
Wiring conditioned takes into the recorder and the step cache, which is HOST13's, #3555.
The agent proposing previews and rendering their clips: HOST5's clip, #3526, is the first.
